positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Making the world of emergencies work faster and safer!

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Architected, built, and deployed a travel app called "TrippleTake", where a user can take an image of a landmark or art piece and get more information about it. The user can ask questions about what's pictured as well as convert the generated image to audio for easy listening. 

Give it a try! https://trippletake.framer.ai/

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and built out a new Postgres database in AWS Aurora for a major app re-architecture. This involved writing data migration scripts and establishing a data migration strategy with product management's feedback. This resulted in migration scripts that could be run idempotently (run many times with the same result), and though the data needed to be migrated across databases, the migration scripts were written efficiently so that thousands or malformed records were processed in less than a minute.

In addition, I integrated Stripe payments with the app so that we could process payments simply and efficiently. This included setting up monitoring and alerting and working with product managers to establish a plan of action in the event failures occurred in payment. As a result, we were able to process payments from every state in the US through our app.

Wrote CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) endpoints in Rust, that leveraged the Diesel Rust crate, as part of the re-architecture. This work resulted in an order of magnitude more efficient endpoint operations for even the most simple queries.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description: Software/data engineer role specializing in processing large amounts of data using spark and Hadoop technologies.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
•	Worked on the optimization team where I built search algorithm we called Reverse Nearest Neighbor Search - a heuristic algorithm that found a solution to the Traveling Salesperson Problem in linear time. This algorithm performed about 31% more efficiently than direct shipments.
•	Supported our engine and API’s with unit and acceptance tests, including exception handling and optimizing inefficient code, which resulted in finding bugs that hadn’t been previously covered. 
•	Presented project to CIO as well as numerous other directors.

projects.title: IQeats
projects.description: We recommend restaurants based off of a users sentiment.

projects.title: MNIST OPTIMAL PARAMETERS
projects.description: Implemented an algorithm with TensorFlow to find the optimal hyper-parameter settings for training on the MNIST data set. MNIST is a hand drawn image classification problem, and our goal was to discover the highest accuracy achievable with only hidden layers. Final results indicated that about 98.2 percent was the highest accuracy achievable given the constraints.
